description: Look up a booking made through Bota: status (confirmed, cancelled…), vehicle, office, dates and total. Needs the booking reference and the email it was made with.

booking_reference.description: Booking reference from the customer's confirmation email.

email.description: Email the booking was made with. Required to prove the customer owns it.

language.description: Language of the conversation, BCP-47 (es, en, pt-BR, fr, de, it…). Defaults to 'en'. Bota also answers in the language the customer writes.

name: get_booking_status
title: Check a booking
